title: LaPaz statement in Aviation Week on two unknown objects

tellings.quote: On August 23rd, 1954, Aviation Week and Space Technology published a statement from LaPaz,

plain: On August 23, 1954, the aviation trade magazine Aviation Week and Space Technology published a statement from Lincoln LaPaz, an astronomer, about two unknown objects linked to White Sands, New Mexico. Michels brings it up himself, alongside the final report of a search called the Near Earth Satellite Project. He tells it because, if true, it would mean unexplained objects were being watched close to Earth in the early 1950s.
